headline.text: L2 ML3 finished the week with a pallet on hold due to *high double/triple rate* — QA and production will decide Monday.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 2 started production at 05:22 after a rusel finex filter electrical issue was worked around. Sollich 3 ran macadamia but went down at 06:35 on matrix seal and C1 belt faults — still troubleshooting at window close. Sollich 4 recovered from a Theegarten bent-arm stop and ran caramel through end of shift.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML3 fought doubles and triples all night, stopping twice to clean the flow wrapper. A partial pallet was placed on hold awaiting decision by Monday. ML2 ran the 24-count changeover after replacing rail 27. FFS finished production and began a level 2 clean for the week.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML1 ran 12-gram bars through the night and completed the order at 06:00. Hopper heater concerns were checked and cleared. A packaging shortage forced use of generic boxes with product on hold. ML4 finished depositing and completed cleaning. Truffle Line ready for Monday.

notes.text: XRay validation completed with Tates Cookies — packing area from check weigher to tape machine needs wipe-down and allergen swabs before Monday almond run.
RF-Smart patch deployed successfully at 06:00 on Saturday to address IMS staging and work order completion issues.
Cleaning rags inventory low across all plants (L1: 13, L2: 68, L3: 74) — supplier contacted to bring more, teams asked to be efficient over weekend cleanings.

resolved.title: Theegarten bent arms on Sollich 4
resolved.summary: THG stopped at 12:32 due to bent arms, halting caramel flow wrapper production.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 12:59 — "up and running again" (Katya Farnsworth). Line resumed and ran through shift.

resolved.title: Rusel finex filter not responding to screen commands
resolved.summary: Filter showed open on screen but was closed and unresponsive, blocking production start on Sollich 2 at 04:55.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 05:55 — maintenance performed manual purge to allow line start, electrical component issue handed off to 1st shift for permanent fix (Jordan Woodcox).

resolved.title: Hopper chocolate buildup and heater uncertainty on Sollich 3
resolved.summary: Thick chocolate layer forming in hopper at 09:18, heater reading max temp but chocolate on pistons not fully liquid at 12:44.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 13:42 — "Maintenance said heater working properly. Operator doing constant temperature checks, readings within range" (Imperial).

resolved.title: ML2 paternoster rail 27 bent again
resolved.summary: Same rail that failed yesterday at 18:48 bent again at 16:07, requiring replacement and deeper maintenance review.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 17:43 — rail replaced, line verified, running 24-count. Maintenance performed deeper dive; replacement rail inspected for foreign material, none found (Wilson Amaris Cabrera).

resolved.title: FFS tape machine failure
resolved.summary: Tape machine stopped FFS line at 21:24, halting pouch production.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 21:37 — "Running again" (VFFS and Mathew Draper). Box print heads cleaned as part of fix.

resolved.title: FFS film jam on new roll
resolved.summary: Line stopped at 01:13 due to open film on new roll changeover.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 01:21 — "Line back up. New roll just needed slight adjustment with smaller sealer bar" (Zack Kurtz).

resolved.title: ML1 C6 belt tracking off
resolved.summary: C6 belt shifted at 13:16, then tracked off again at 03:47 requiring maintenance adjustment both times.
resolved.resolution: First occurrence cleared at 13:39 — "Belt C6 running correctly" after maintenance adjustments. Second occurrence cleared ~03:55 — line down 15 minutes, "started running back at 03:10" (Raoul Lubain).

needs_attention.title: Sollich 3 matrix seals not moving and C1 belt faulting
needs_attention.summary: Line stopped at 06:35 when matrix seals failed to respond, followed by C1 belt faults at 06:57.
needs_attention.status: Troy Baxter and Lolo working on-site as of 06:57. Line remains down at window close.

needs_attention.title: Allergen control cleaning required before Monday
needs_attention.summary: XRay validation used Tates Cookies; packing area from check weigher to tape machine has cookie dust in closed pouches and needs wipe-down plus allergen swabs before Monday almond run.
needs_attention.status: Cleaning request submitted at 19:51. Asking if it can be done tonight or tomorrow to avoid almond cross-contact Monday.

needs_attention.title: Labeler issues on Sollich 2
needs_attention.summary: Labeler malfunctioning at end of shift, impacting packaging on caramel line.
needs_attention.status: Troy Baxter on-site helping with 1st shift lead as of 07:15.

needs_attention.title: ML3 high double and triple reject rate with pallet on hold
needs_attention.summary: Flow wrapper produced excessive doubles and triples throughout 3rd shift despite two cleaning stops; partial pallet placed on hold with large number of defects.
needs_attention.status: Line stopped twice for FW cleaning (00:40 and 02:22). Quality issue persisted. Pallet on hold awaiting decision from quality or production department by Monday (Jose Cabrera, 07:05).

needs_attention.title: ML2 missing key 13 from shadow board
needs_attention.summary: Key 13 missing at start and end of 3rd shift, impacting tool accountability.
needs_attention.status: Noted missing at 21:52 shift start and still missing at 06:29 shift end.

needs_attention.title: ML4 west Swaco grease line broken
needs_attention.summary: Grease line broken on west Swaco for depositor 1 found during PM; needs broken part removed and line reinstalled during tonight's cleaning.
needs_attention.status: Rich Brierley asked to add to action list. Later noted this is second grease pipe failure (top hose this time, bottom hose last time). Kavin Ayala believes Sweco vibrating more/higher than others, fittings breaking at threads (Kimberly Morales, 07:04).

needs_attention.title: ML1 bulk box packaging shortage, product on hold
needs_attention.summary: Ran out of item 41238 bulk boxes at 16:15, switched to generic boxes; all production using generic boxes placed on hold per QA.
needs_attention.status: QA informed at 16:15. Later found 28 pallets with correct bulk box physically present but labels have incorrect description and item number — QA placing those on hold as well (Angel Cabrera, 17:47).

needs_attention.title: ML1 temptek machine leak
needs_attention.summary: Leak observed on temptek machine at 16:33, maintenance called.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance called at 16:33. No update on resolution in chat.

needs_attention.title: ML1 buffer tank low temperature
needs_attention.summary: Buffer tank temperature dropped below range at 03:41, maintenance called.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance called at 03:41. Glycol level noted as normal but needing top-off at 03:42.

needs_attention.title: ML4 door before cooler 2 won't open properly
needs_attention.summary: Door hitting on top but not bottom, preventing proper opening.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance looking at it as of 21:36. No resolution posted.
